title: Red mercury black market after the Soviet collapse

tellings.quote: coming out of the former Soviet Union were all these stories about this substance called red mercury that was uh alleged to have these amazing properties and that it was being sold on the black market and so on.

plain: As the Soviet Union fell apart, stories spread of a substance called red mercury, said to have amazing properties and to be sold on the black market. A former Senate staffer named Kurt McConnell brings this up on the show as a summary of those old stories, without naming a source. He tells it as an example of the strange claims about secret materials that came out of the former Soviet Union.
